Hi Camila,

We came across Redwood on the Cloud Marketplace and I wanted to reach out to see if someone could give us a short demo. We're evaluating inference platforms to replace some on-prem systems for lower latency and predictable cost. Specific items we care about: VPC/private deployment, KMS/HSM compatibility, and burst autoscaling.

Would love a 30-minute intro + live demo next week if possible. Our calendar is a bit tight but we can prioritize.

Attached: short RFP excerpt (bluewave-rfp.pdf).
